prompts.camera: Use case: scientific-educational visual asset, NOT a diagram. Create one isolated, unbranded compact machine-vision camera module as a publication-quality raster icon for a research methodology figure. Matte dark graphite and silver housing, a short circular lens with restrained blue glass highlights. Slight three-quarter product illustration, soft controlled lighting, crisp simple silhouette, enough material detail to feel tangible but readable at a 12 mm printed width. The camera is a representative illustrative object, not a real experimental apparatus or a specified product. Center the single object and let it occupy about 85 percent of a square canvas. Genuinely transparent background, preserve alpha, no ground plane or cast shadow extending far outside the object. Do not generate ANY text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, arrows, axes, connectors, badges, frames, callouts, plots or surrounding diagram. Only the camera asset; all figure annotations will be made separately as editable PowerPoint text.
